decisions.reason: The check-in app extends the firm's long experience in passenger profiling and document verification at airports, so it can interpret early results and refine the app as air travel recovers in 2022, though consumer-facing apps sit somewhat further from its security core.

PassBoard builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of aviation security and passenger processing, so it has the absorptive capacity to improve the technology after the COVID downturn rather than abandon it.

Self-service check-in fits the firm's passenger-handling expertise and probably forms part of the same PassBoard suite, though the crowded airline IT market and missing evidence for 2020–2021 add some risk.
